description: A unified day-by-day content calendar across every brand this login holds (1 to 31 days, default 14): every scheduled, published and failed post tagged with its brandId and brandName, plus per-brand summaries and overall counts. Ideal for agencies reviewing all clients at once. Changes nothing.

days.description: How many consecutive calendar days to aggregate across every brand (1 to 31). Defaults to 14.

from.description: Start calendar date formatted as YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

name: brands_calendar_get
title: Read all-brands calendar
